_comment: Shape reference for a collect run (prove:tingle-live). Every value below
is invented — no real site was scraped to produce this file.
Real collect runs are gitignored, because evidencing a live scrape means
recording someone else's URLs and titles. Run the script yourself to see
the real thing; it writes to docs/proof/tingle/live/, which stays on disk.
